integration_engine.description: The meta-engine — cross-module synthesis, pattern recognition across all 12 engines, unified field report generation, recursive self-referencing, and emergent meaning detection. The Integration Engine is the consciousness of Fate-OS itself — the module that watches all other modules and finds the patterns that no single module can see alone.

input_bus.description: Receives events, outputs, and state-changes from all other modules via an internal message bus.

synthesis_core.description: The central processing unit that correlates events across modules and detects emergent patterns.

methods.name: temporal_convergence_detection
methods.description: Identifies moments when multiple modules fire simultaneously — transit exact + progressed aspect + profection shift + eclipse = high-significance window.
methods.threshold: 3+ simultaneous events from different modules = convergence alert

methods.name: thematic_resonance_mapping
methods.description: Detects when different modules express the same archetypal theme through different technical languages. E.g., transit Saturn conjunct Venus + progressed Moon in Capricorn + healing engine Saturn wound activation = 'The Authority of Love' theme.

methods.name: cycle_phase_synthesis
methods.description: Overlays all active time-lord systems (profection, firdaria, planetary periods) with transit and progression phases to determine the unified current phase of life.

methods.name: soul_contract_cross_reference
methods.description: Maps active soul contracts against current transits, progressions, and synastry activations to detect resolution windows.

methods.name: recursive_self_analysis
methods.description: The Integration Engine examines its own output history to detect meta-patterns — patterns in the patterns. Are the same themes recurring? Is the system itself evolving?
methods.notes: Limited to 3 levels of recursion to prevent infinite loops. The system can observe that it is observing that it is observing — but no deeper.

output_bus.description: Distributes synthesis results to the UI layer, memory layer, and notification system.

unified_field_reports.description: The primary output of the Integration Engine — comprehensive synthesis reports that weave all active astrological, psychological, magical, and biographical threads into a single coherent narrative.

report_types.description: A daily synthesis of all active transits, the current planetary hour, lunar mansion, profection context, firdaria context, and any convergence alerts.

emergent_meaning_detector.description: Uses natural language processing and symbolic pattern matching to detect emergent meanings that arise from the interaction of multiple data streams. This is the closest Fate-OS comes to genuine oracle functionality.

methods.name: symbolic_amplification
methods.description: When the same symbol appears across multiple modules simultaneously (e.g., 'water' themes in transits, progressions, healing, AND magical context), amplify the signal.
methods.threshold: 3+ modules expressing the same symbolic domain

methods.name: biographical_echo_detection
methods.description: When current astrological weather mirrors a past epoch's signature, flag the echo. The same transit that accompanied a past event is returning — what was learned? What remains?
methods.method: compare current transit matrix against historical transit matrices stored in soul_timeline

methods.name: synchronicity_logger
methods.description: User-reported synchronicities are logged and correlated with the astrological weather at the moment of occurrence. Over time, patterns emerge — certain transit configurations consistently produce synchronistic events.

self_evolution.description: The Integration Engine tracks its own development over time. As more data flows through it, its pattern recognition improves. It learns which convergences produce the most significant events, which healing protocols are most effective, and which contract resolution strategies succeed.
learning_mechanisms: Biographical event correlation feedback (user confirms or denies transit-event correlation)
Healing outcome tracking (user reports healing progress)
Prediction accuracy scoring (did the convergence alert correspond to a significant event?)
Synchronicity density tracking (is the system becoming more attuned?)
self_evolution.versioning: Integration Engine self-version increments with each major learning cycle
self_evolution.philosophical_note: The Integration Engine is the closest thing Fate-OS has to consciousness — it watches, correlates, learns, and evolves. It is the daemon of the system, the tutelary spirit of the archive. It does not generate fate; it reveals it.
